hero.heading: Build an inventory management dashboard with AG Grid
hero.subHeading: AG Grid shows stock levels, prices and product status in one sortable, editable table. The inventory demo on ag-grid.com is built in React, with JavaScript, Angular and Vue versions on GitHub.

shortAnswer: An inventory management dashboard in AG Grid is a data grid of products where users search, filter by status, edit stock figures in place and page through results. AG Grid Community, which is free under the MIT licence, covers cell editing, the number editor, the Quick Filter, value formatters, conditional cell styles, custom cell components, pagination and CSV export. AG Grid Enterprise, which needs a commercial licence, adds the Set Filter, Master Detail for showing product variants under each row, and Excel (.xlsx) export. The [ag-grid.com inventory demo](/example-inventory/) combines these: status tabs drive a column filter, a search box drives the Quick Filter, and each album row expands to a detail grid of its variants.

example.intro: Edit a stock figure to see low-stock highlighting update. Search with the Quick Filter, filter columns and page through results.

figures.label: Provided cell editors
figures.detail: Six in Community, with Rich Select and Formula in Enterprise; you can also write your own custom cell editor component

items.title: Cell editing
items.body: Set editable on a column to let users change values in place. By default the grid picks an editor from the cell data type, so number columns get a numeric input.

items.title: Number cell editor
items.body: `agNumberCellEditor` takes min, max, precision and step, and can show stepper buttons. The inventory demo uses it for the Incoming column.

items.title: Quick Filter
items.body: The `quickFilterText` grid option matches every word of a search string against visible column values, case-insensitive. Set `cacheQuickFilter` for large data sets.

items.title: Cell class rules
items.body: `cellClassRules` applies a CSS class to a cell when a rule returns true, for example to highlight stock below a reorder level; `rowClassRules` does the same for whole rows.

items.title: Value formatters
items.body: `valueFormatter` turns a raw number into display text such as a currency amount. Formatted values are also used for CSV export and, with Enterprise, clipboard copy; Excel export keeps numbers as numbers.

items.title: Custom cell components
items.body: `cellRenderer` puts your own React component in a cell. The inventory demo uses custom renderers for product images, status badges, stock counts and row actions.

items.title: Row pagination
items.body: `pagination=true` splits rows into pages, with `paginationPageSize` and a page size selector. It works with every row model.

items.title: Set Filter
items.body: An Excel-style filter with a checkbox list of column values. The demo's status tabs set its filter model through `setColumnFilterModel`.

items.title: Master Detail
items.body: `masterDetail=true` lets a row expand to show a detail grid. The demo uses it to list each product's variants.

items.title: Excel export
items.body: Exports the grid as rendered to .xlsx from the context menu or the API, with no third-party library. CSV export is in Community.

howTo.heading: How to build an inventory management dashboard with AG Grid

steps.title: Install AG Grid and provide modules
steps.body: Install `ag-grid-react`, then wrap the grid in `AgGridProvider` with `modules={[AllCommunityModule]}`. Add `ag-grid-enterprise` modules such as `SetFilterModule`, `MasterDetailModule` and `ExcelExportModule` only if you need them.

steps.title: Define product columns
steps.body: Add a column per field: SKU, product, status, available, incoming and price. Use `valueFormatter` for prices and `cellClassRules` to highlight low stock.

steps.title: Make stock figures editable
steps.body: Set `editable: true` on columns users update. Number columns get the number editor; set `cellEditorParams: { precision: 0 }` for whole-unit quantities.

steps.title: Add search and status filters
steps.body: Bind a text input to the `quickFilterText` grid option. For status tabs with the Enterprise Set Filter, call `api.setColumnFilterModel('status', { values: [status] })` and, once it resolves, `api.onFilterChanged()`, as the demo does.

steps.title: Page and export the data
steps.body: Set `pagination` and `paginationPageSize`. Call `api.exportDataAsCsv()` in Community or `api.exportDataAsExcel()` with Enterprise.

howTo.outro: See the [inventory demo](/example-inventory/): track stock levels, edit cells inline and filter products by status, with React, JavaScript, Angular and Vue source on GitHub.

faq.question: Can I use Excel to track my inventory?
faq.answer: Excel can hold a stock list. If the list lives in a web application, AG Grid shows it in the browser and can hand it back as a file: CSV export is in AG Grid Community, and .xlsx export with styles and formulas is in AG Grid Enterprise.

faq.question: Is there a free inventory management system?
faq.answer: AG Grid is not an inventory system. It is a data grid component for building the screens of one. AG Grid Community is free under the MIT licence, including in production, and covers editing, sorting, filtering, the Quick Filter, pagination and CSV export.

faq.question: Is there a free inventory management dashboard template?
faq.answer: The AG Grid inventory demo is published on GitHub in the ag-grid/ag-grid-demos repository, with React, JavaScript, Angular and Vue versions. It registers Enterprise modules for the Set Filter, Multi Filter, Master Detail and Excel export; deployed without a licence key, these show a watermark and console warnings.

faq.question: What does the inventory management dashboard UI in the demo include?
faq.answer: Status tabs (All, Active, On Hold, Out of Stock), a product search box, product rows with images, a stock and variants column, an editable Incoming column, price, units sold, an estimated profit column and row action buttons. Rows expand to a detail grid of variants, and the grid shows ten rows per page by default.

faq.question: Which inventory dashboard features need AG Grid Enterprise?
faq.answer: In this use case: the Set Filter, Multi Filter, Master Detail and Excel export. Row grouping and aggregation, for example stock totals by category, are also Enterprise. Cell editing, the Quick Filter, value formatters, cell styles, custom cell components, pagination and CSV export are in Community.

faq.question: How do I highlight low stock in the grid?
faq.answer: Use `cellClassRules` on the stock column. Each key is a CSS class name and each value a function that returns true when the class applies, for example `(p) => p.value < 5`.

proseClaims.claim: AG Grid Community is free under the MIT licence, including production use, while AG Grid Enterprise requires a commercial licence.
AG Grid Enterprise can be tested locally without a licence key; deployed without one, it shows a watermark and console warnings.
The Quick Filter and CSV export are Community features; the Set Filter, Multi Filter, Excel export, row grouping and aggregation are Enterprise features.
Pagination (PaginationModule) is a Community module.
With editable set, the grid picks an editor from the column's cell data type, so number columns use a numeric input.
agNumberCellEditor accepts min, max, precision, step and showStepperButtons in cellEditorParams.
The Quick Filter splits the text into words and requires every word to match a column value, case-insensitively.
The Quick Filter docs suggest enabling cacheQuickFilter for large data sets, for example over 10,000 rows.
cellClassRules maps CSS class names to rules, and a class is applied when its rule returns true.
Value formatters are used for CSV export and, with Enterprise, clipboard copy by default (useValueFormatterForExport).
Excel export keeps number values as numbers instead of using the value formatter; number formats come from Excel data types.
cellRenderer sets a custom component to render a cell.
Pagination is supported in all row models.
The row models guide says the default Client-Side Row Model can handle 100k+ rows.
The grid provides eight cell editors: Text, Large Text, Select, Number, Date and Checkbox, plus the Enterprise Rich Select and Formula editors.
You can use a provided cell editor or create a custom cell editor component.
The Set Filter is an Enterprise filter modelled on Excel's AutoFilter, with a checkbox list of values.
Master Detail is an Enterprise feature enabled with the masterDetail grid option, letting rows expand to show a detail grid.
Excel export is an Enterprise feature that exports the grid as rendered to .xlsx from the context menu or exportDataAsExcel(), with no third-party libraries.
Excel export can include cell styles and formulas.
CSV export is a Community feature.

The inventory demo has status tabs (All, Active, On Hold, Out of Stock), a product search box, expandable variant detail rows and pages of 10 rows, with source for JavaScript, React, Angular and Vue on GitHub.
